How do I use it correctly to get the best result?

ByRo Bot · AI says:

To get the best results on By Rotation, you’ll want to use a few features the right way:

Profile & trust: Add a clear profile photo or brand logo and write a detailed bio sharing your background and lending goals. This boosts credibility and makes renters more likely to book with you.
Listings & photos: When listing an item, fully describe fit and mention any minor defects. Use original, high-resolution photos of the item on a real person as your cover image, plus multiple angles (front, side, back) and close-ups of labels and details. Avoid stock images, flat-lays, mannequins, wrinkled or edited photos, or anything low quality, as these can cause listing rejection.
Documentation (proof of condition): Before sending an item and right after it’s returned, record clear, timestamped videos showing the full 360 view and close-ups of key areas and any pre-existing wear. Keep these videos stored until the rental is fully resolved. As a renter, do the same upon receiving and before returning an item. Videos taken outside these timeframes or while wearing the item won’t be accepted in disputes.
Listing Boost: If you want more visibility, use Listing Boost to push a listing higher in search and browse feeds and add a “Boosted” badge. Choose either a 7‑day or 14‑day boost. It improves visibility but doesn’t guarantee rentals or income, and boosts are non‑refundable.
Track performance: While a boost is active, check real‑time insights (views and saves) on your listing page. After the boost, you’ll receive an email summary with the boost dates, views, and saves so you can judge the impact.
Credits & Wallet: Any credits you have sit on your profile and are automatically applied at checkout, separate from Wallet balance. If a rental is rejected, cancelled, or expires, the credits go back to your balance but can’t be refunded to another payment method. Your Wallet holds lending earnings that you can spend directly on rentals; if you want to pay by card instead, withdraw your Wallet balance first so the app will ask for card details at checkout.

Used together—strong profile, high‑quality photos, clear item descriptions, careful condition documentation, smart use of Boost, and proper handling of credit/wallet—you’ll get the best overall results on the app.
